A clear path from presence to measurable value

Review

Find your listing and check its identity, category, geography, source date and qualified website route.

Correct

Prepare factual corrections without paying. Franklin Navigator never sells accuracy.

Choose a goal

Focus on stronger discovery, trust, conversion, local relationships or community participation.

Improve your presence

Match richer profile, media, call-to-action and multi-location capabilities to your vertical and organization size.

Participate locally

Plan eligible offers, events, community programs and collaborations without confusing promotion with organic relevance.

Measure responsibly

Separate views and interactions from leads, customers and revenue; never promise an outcome the evidence cannot prove.

Trust is part of the product

  • Free profiles and factual corrections remain useful.
  • Membership never rewrites facts, licensing, suitability or safety.
  • Sponsored placement must be clearly labeled.
  • No guaranteed leads, customers, revenue or outcomes.
  • No sale of confidential resident information.

Provisional membership pricing is published for review. Enrollment, checkout, billing and paid entitlements are not active on this site.
